One sentence, winding through nine steps. (Galatians — the whole letter, mapped)

Before we walk it verse by verse, here's the map: how the single cry of grace flows from chapter 1 to chapter 6 in nine steps. Galatians isn't a pile of rules — it's one argument, one thread, one Person. Keep this as your guide, and you'll never lose the shape of the whole while we linger on each verse.
